analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나(35.3→39.3), MACD 히스토그램은 악화(-6.0682→-9.3216)되며 약세 수렴 중이다. 5일 연속 음봉 이후 반등 시도했으나 거래량(0.63배)이 동반되지 않아 추세 전환 신뢰도가 낮다. 주봉상 ADX 22.9로 추세 초기 단계이며, -DI(38.3)가 +DI(17.0)보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력이 지속될 가능성이 있다. 52주 저가 대비 21.5% 위치로 추가 하락 여력은 제한적이나, 명확한 매수 신호 부재로 관망이 합리적이다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory (35.3→39.3), but MACD histogram is worsening (-6.0682→-9.3216) and showing bearish convergence. Despite an attempted rebound after 5 consecutive down days, the lack of accompanying volume (0.63x average) lowers confidence in a trend reversal. The weekly ADX is at 22.9, indicating an early stage of a trend, and -DI (38.3) remains above +DI (17.0), suggesting continued downward pressure. At 21.5% above the 52-week low, further downside potential appears limited, but the absence of clear buy signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($269.33) vs SMA5/20/50 ($263.17/$323.01/$348.69): Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50, indicating a weak zone.
· Significantly below SMA100/200 ($382.32/$405.88), signaling weakened long-term trend.
· 52-week position (21.5%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.3→39.3) + Exited oversold but before entering neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.0682→-9.3216) + Continued worsening, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $237.66) + Bandwidth 52.85%, indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($238.57) + Based on 5-day low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing resistance ($365.90) + Approaching SMA50 and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (maintaining lows) + Potential for decline after consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.63x) + Subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (potential entry into accumulation phase but lacking clear signals) + Meeting conditions for observation.
